operatingRules.noReminders: Nothing here reminds you. There is no scheduler behind these numbers — they are notes to yourself.

operatingRules.templatesNoCredentials: No platform passwords, anywhere. The system never signs in for you.

operatingRules.reviewHint: SOP 3.2: on your own, you review your own work.
operatingRules.reviewTeamLater: Later work. Nothing here can assign a reviewer yet, which is why there is no picker to grey out.
operatingRules.observationHint: How long after publishing to go copy the numbers back. It is a note to yourself — nothing will chase you — but "Feedback to record" on Today uses this number to decide what it lists.
operatingRules.observationDefaultHint: Days after publishing. Leave blank and there is no answer to "is it due" — which is better than a number nobody chose.
operatingRules.observationChannelPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the brand's
operatingRules.observationUnset: Not set — "is it due" has no answer yet
operatingRules.saveHint: Only these settings are written. Your timezone and precheck switch are untouched.

contentRoiReview.notePlaceholder: A note on this entry or change (optional)
contentRoiReview.amountHint: Type it as text, for example 3000.00. It is never rounded for you.

amountProblems.format: Not an amount. Type a number such as 3000.00

reasons.currency_unconverted: A currency is not converted. Enter a rate in the report parameters
reasons.labor_rate_missing: No hourly rate for the labor time
reasons.refund_without_gross_delta: A refund does not say how gross profit changed

metrics.cost_per_qualified_lead: Cost per qualified lead (spend ÷ qualified leads)

formulas.spend_total: Sum of valid costs in the window after conversion (with a scope, only the shares inside it)
formulas.ad_spend_total: The part of it marked as ad spend
formulas.qualified_leads: Qualified leads first recorded in the window, each lead once
formulas.bookings: Leads at the chosen booking stage, each lead once
formulas.deals: Deals in the window, each deal once
formulas.net_revenue: Confirmed deal amounts − refunds and adjustments
formulas.attributed_net_revenue: Net revenue shared out to the accepted touches by the attribution method
formulas.attributed_gross_profit: Gross profit shared out to the accepted touches by the attribution method
formulas.attribution_coverage_count: Attributed deals ÷ deals in the window
formulas.attribution_coverage_amount: Net revenue of attributed deals ÷ net revenue of deals in the window
formulas.conversion_rate: Leads that reached the numerator stage ÷ leads that reached the denominator stage
formulas.cost_per_qualified_lead: Content and marketing spend ÷ qualified leads
formulas.business_roi: (Attributed gross profit − content and marketing spend) ÷ content and marketing spend
formulas.revenue_to_spend: Attributed net revenue ÷ content and marketing spend
formulas.ad_roas: Net revenue shared to paid touches ÷ ad spend

costs.createDescription: A cost that spans months is not split for you: split it by month under "Shares", or all of it falls in the month it was incurred.
costs.categoryHint: For example: planning, labor, filming, editing, ads.
costs.laborRateHint: You can leave it empty: the amount then shows "Not computable: no hourly rate", never 0.
costs.adSpendHint: Counts toward ad spend, used for ad ROAS.
costs.sharesHint: Split a shared cost across works, accounts, campaigns or periods. The original amount stays the same.
costs.sharesMatch: Total {{total}}, equal to the original amount
costs.sharesGap: Total {{total}}, differs from the original {{original}} by {{gap}}

leads.createDescription: You can record a lead without knowing who the customer is. Touches (where the customer came from) are added in the lead's detail.
leads.customerRefHint: Use a pseudonym or a number. Do not enter a real name or contact details.
leads.stageHint: Free text. You can pick a stage used before.
leads.mergeDescription: Merge this lead into another: its touches show under the target, and the brand counts the target once. No touch is deleted or changed, and the merge can be undone.
leads.mergeNeeds: Choose a target lead and give a reason.
leads.touchesDescription: A touch records how the customer came. It is evidence, not a judgement. Which touches a deal is credited to is judged separately, on the deal.
leads.evidenceHint: One of six. There is no "other". Fields that do not apply to the type are disabled.
leads.paidHint: A touch from paid ads, used for ad ROAS.

deals.createDescription: The amount is the confirmed deal amount. The gross profit basis decides whether the report can compute the business ROI.
deals.orderRefHint: When an order reference is given, duplicates are found by it.
deals.grossBasisHint: With "No gross profit basis", the business ROI shows "Not computable: no gross profit basis"; the revenue-to-spend ratio is still computed.
deals.grossFromCogs: Confirmed amount {{amount}} − cost of goods sold {{cogs}} ({{currency}}); the gross profit is computed by the server in the report.
deals.grossInReport: There are refunds or adjustments; the gross profit is computed by the server in the report.
deals.adjustmentsDescription: Each refund or adjustment is its own record, in the deal's currency.
deals.revenueDeltaHint: A positive number is a reduction: for a refund of 1000.00 type 1000.00 ({{currency}}). An adjustment may be negative to mean an increase.
deals.grossDeltaHint: For a deal with a gross profit basis, give the gross profit reduction of a refund; without it the deal's gross profit is not computable.
deals.grossDeltaWillStore: Will be saved as {{value}} {{currency}} (negative means a reduction)
deals.attributionDescription: This is your judgement, not evidence. Saving it changes no touch.
deals.noJudgement: No judgement yet. A deal without one counts under "Source unknown / not judged" in reports.
deals.noLeadNoTouches: This deal has no lead, so there are no touches to accept.
deals.weightsHint: Optional: give each checked touch a whole-number weight. Give all or none.
deals.weightsInvalid: Leave every weight empty, or make each one a whole number above 0.
deals.judgementNotEvidence: This is your judgement, not evidence.

imports.title: Import
imports.description: Paste table text. Preview first: rows with errors are named and nothing is sent; rows that look like duplicates of existing records are not imported by default.
imports.columnsHint: Columns (the first line may be the column names): {{columns}}

csvReasons.unknown-column: not a column of this kind of record
csvReasons.outside-the-set: not one of the allowed values

outcomes.willWriteConfirmed: Confirmed not a duplicate, will be written
outcomes.confirmed: Confirmed not a duplicate, written as {{id}}
outcomes.duplicate: Possible duplicate: same as {{ids}}, not imported

imports.submitHint: Only rows that are not duplicates, or that you confirmed are not, are written. Clicking twice does not write twice.
imports.batchDetailTitle: Row by row results of the batch

report.paramsDescription: You choose the window, currency, rates, attribution method and stages; the server does the calculation.
report.windowBackwards: The end is before the start.
report.timezone: Read in the brand time zone {{timezone}}
report.ratesHint: Records in a currency without a rate make the related metrics not computable; nothing is converted for you.
report.rateInvalid: Check the rates: each must be a positive number and not the report currency.
report.methodHint: Decides how a deal with several touches is shared out among them.
report.stageLimitation: Stages are free text with no order; the conversion rate only counts whether a lead ever reached a stage, not the order of stages.
report.scopeHint: Choose none for the whole brand. The scope only applies to spend and to the shares that go to works and accounts.
report.runHint: Preview calculates without saving; Generate saves a report version.
report.previewNotSaved: This is a preview. It is not saved.
report.regenerate: Generate a new version from the latest records
report.regenerateHint: Uses the previous version's parameters for the next version; the old version stays unchanged.
report.inputsChangedHint: This version's figures do not change. To see results from the latest records, generate a new version.
report.changeGone: {{record}}: this version used revision {{revision}}; it is no longer included
report.changeRevised: {{record}}: this version used revision {{from}}; it is now revision {{to}}
report.fraction: Numerator {{numerator}} / denominator {{denominator}} (minor currency units or counts)
report.breakdownNotAdditive: The same deal can appear under several works; these do not add up.
report.breakdownEmpty: No shares attributed to works or accounts.
report.evenSplitFallback: These deals have no manual weights and were split evenly
report.aiPending: Pending: not available (the executor is disabled). Nothing below was generated.

search_optimization.fixedGuidance: Answer the question. Keep evidence and the source version visible. One observation is not a stable or platform-wide rank.
search_optimization.loadFailed: Could not load these records. Refresh and try again.
search_optimization.invalidContext: The selected topic, publication and account do not match. Choose compatible records.

values.no_data_source: No search data source is available in this version.

themes.unknown: Unknown (no search data interface in this version)

suggestions.description: Suggestions remain attached to a work, document, topic and exact base version.
suggestions.question: Question to answer
suggestions.search: Filter question, covered items or evidence
suggestions.searchHint: Search questions, items, reasons, text or evidence IDs
